models.name: X-75-OPTO-Pro
models.firmware_note: protection threshold 12.0 V stated for this type in the leaflet

entry.confirm_signal: Two low tones then two high tones ('_ _ - -') about 5 s after power-up.
steps: Connect the drive battery (switch on where fitted); Opto versions need an external supply for the receiver connected first.
Wait 5 s for the two low plus two high tones.
Brake: move throttle to stop right after these tones.
Other items: keep full throttle until the wanted pattern sounds; move throttle to stop while its five repetitions are playing.

announce.description: Each selectable setting has its own tone pattern, shown five times in a row, then the next setting follows in the order of the list (battery type, under-voltage behaviour, acceleration, timing, frequency, rotation reverse, rpm control). One pattern names item and value together: battery type uses N short beeps per group (NiCd one, 2 cells two and so on), timing uses 1 to 3 high tones, acceleration uses V, VV, VVV, 8 kHz is a falling and 16 kHz a rising tone. Symbols as printed: '.' short low beep, '-' short high beep, '_' long tone, '\' falling, '/' rising, 'V' high-low-high, 'W' doubled V. A pattern ends after its fifth repetition. Whether the list loops is not stated.

select.description: Move the throttle to stop while the wanted series of five patterns is sounding.

skip.description: Keep full throttle to pass every pattern.

scheme.confirm_signal: None named; the ESC leaves programming mode and the motor runs on throttle movement. Normal start-up then announces the cell count followed by one beep (brake on) or two (brake off).
scheme.exit: Automatic after the single change; disconnect the battery before another change. If the programming mode starts by mistake, disconnecting the battery prevents a change.
scheme.description: Full throttle at power-up gives two low plus two high tones after 5 s. Stop right after them toggles the brake. Otherwise full throttle is kept; each setting sounds as a five-times repeated pattern and stop during one stores it. One change per entry. Choosing any battery type by stick turns LiPo autodetect off; it can be switched on again only with the USB interface.

values.name: toggle brake: on becomes off, off becomes on

items.name: Battery type / cutoff
items.note: Value numbers are beep counts per group; NiCd is one beep. Factory state is LiPo autodetect at 3.2 V per cell (pack above 3.8 V per cell needed), which has no pattern.

items.name: Acceleration
items.note: Factory acceleration is 'fast'; its position among the three is not stated.

items.name: Active rpm control (heli, governor)
items.note: Electrical rpm of a 2-pole motor: divide by 2 for 4 poles, by 5 for 10 poles. The leaflet gives 7 for 14 poles.

unknowns: Beep and tone lengths, gaps, gap between patterns (ms): not stated.
Order in which patterns sound: printed list order assumed, not stated.
Whether the list loops after the last pattern: not stated.
Length of the brake window after the first tones ('as soon as you hear'): not stated.
Position of 'fast' acceleration among low, medium, high: not stated.
Number of beeps used for the NiCd entry: German 2016 text says one, the pattern rows show five groups.
notes: Cutoff voltages: 3 LiPo cells 8.7 V, 4 cells 11.6 V, 5 cells 14.5 V in Hacker_X-Pro.pdf, Hacker_X-Pro_rev3_en.pdf and Hacker_X-Pro_series_leaflet.pdf; 8.3 V, 11.3 V, 14.2 V in Hacker_X-Pro_Regler_de.pdf (2016).
Hacker_X-Pro_Regler_de.pdf p8 labels the '_' symbol 'long high beep' in the English text and 'langer tiefer Ton' (long low tone) in the German text.
Hacker_X-Pro_Regler_de.pdf p8 row 5S reads '5 short beeps / 2 short beeps'; read as five.
Hacker_X-Pro.pdf is the 03/08 print and Hacker_X-Pro_rev3_en.pdf the 06/07 print; their text is identical except the date.
Models: only Hacker_X-Pro_Regler_de.pdf p4 has a model table. Voltage maximum is 4.2 V per cell times the highest LiPo count.
The power-off threshold is 5.5 V, 12.0 V for the X-75-Opto (leaflet p6).
The manual does not permit power supplies, only batteries.
Opto versions need an external receiver supply connected before the drive battery.
The USB interface (order no. 87201006) offers more settings: variable LiPo cutoff, brake off/soft/hard, finer timing, three acceleration stages; not a stick method.
